[1] arXiv:2512.00001
Title: Topological flat bands in twisted bilayer geometry
Authors: Alice Author, Bob Bloch
Subjects: Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)

We study topological flat bands in a twisted bilayer system. The Berry curvature is computed numerically and shown to host a topological phase transition driven by interaction strength. Implications for synthetic gauge fields are discussed.
